question: Related Questions Q. June 19, 2009 Assalamualaikum Wo Rahmathullahi Barkathahu, My name is Mohammed Safiulla from Bangalore, India. Kindly let me know the Fatwa in light of Quran and Sunnah. My Father in law passed away last year. May Allah reward him with a place in Jannathul firdose. Amin. Summ Amin. My deceased Father in law has two sons-one married and the other a bachelor and one daughter who is also married. I would like to know how the property that used to be owned by my deceased father in law need to be distributed. My mother in law is alive and she is taking the family pension. Also let me know whether the children have any rights in the deceased?s pension also. Also my deceased father in law has got some ancestral property from his father. Kindly let me know whether the grand children (two grand sons and a grand daughter) have got any right in this property. Please note that there is no WILL on any of the properties by my deceased Father in law. Your earliest reply would be highly appreciated. 1676 views Q. Inheritance 1857 views Q. answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 179961 Country: India Title: Property distribution among one brother and four sisters Question: We are 5 siblings in which I am brother and rest 4 are my sisters. I have to divide my father’s property which is 8 katha. How much share each one we will get? Answer ID: 179961 Posted on: Oct 13, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 71/54/M=2/1442) If your father is no more and your mother is also not alive and the heirs are only you and your four sisters, then the property left by your deceased father shall be divided into 6 shares after paying due rights preceding inheritance. Out of total, you (brother) shall get 2 shares, while each sister shall get 1-1- share. And if the case is something else then you may write it clearly and submit the question again. The Shariah division of the property is as follows: Details: Son: 1x2 = 2 Daughters: 4x1 = 4 Total: 6 Shares Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
